title: 第006章 众人登门求诊治，少女深夜戒凶徒
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

甲等单间！

外门居所分甲乙丙三等，甲等单间宽敞清净，灵气汇聚，是外门中资质顶尖、深受器重的弟子才能入住的地方。

蔡文龙身为单灵根的天才，也只分到了乙等群居院落。

而他心目中人人鄙夷的废柴堂妹，居然一进门就住上了甲等单间？

巨大的落差让他心底的戾气越发浓重，看向蔡文姬的眼神里，敌意几乎达到极致。

蔡文姬对此倒是无所谓，住哪里都一样，只要能安稳落脚，慢慢积蓄力量就行。

她躬身谢过周管事，接过门牌与宗门服饰，跟着引路弟子前往外门甲等居所。

单间院落不大，一屋一院，院中种着几株翠竹，清风穿竹，沙沙作响，环境清幽雅致，确实适合静心。

简单收拾一番后，蔡文姬换上了宗门统一的浅青色外门服饰，软萌的小脸衬上素净衣衫，别有一番灵动韵味。

刚安顿下来，院落外就传来了敲门声。

开门一看，竟是先前被她治好旧伤的那名外门修士，身后还跟着好几名同门。

“蔡师妹，在下王磊，今日多谢师妹出手相救，大恩不言谢！”

王磊拱手行礼，态度十分诚恳：

“听闻师妹精通疗愈之术，我们几个平日里修炼、历练或多或少都有一些小伤小痛，特来登门，想麻烦师妹帮忙梳理一二。”

原来王磊回去之后，将自己多年顽疾被蔡文姬轻松治愈的事情传开了。

整个外门瞬间炸开了锅！

在资源贫瘠、丹药稀少的清风宗，能免费疗伤，简直是天大的好事！

一时间，外门不少弟子纷纷找上门来，排着队想让蔡文姬帮忙调理伤势。

蔡文姬看着门外乌泱泱一群人，瞬间悟了。

好家伙，合着她刚进宗门，就被当成专属移动血包了？

峡谷里队友抢着喊“奶妈保我”，到了修真界，全宗门弟子排队求“师妹救我”，这画风简直一模一样！

她哭笑不得，却也没有拒绝。

一来，救人积累功德，能滋养自身音律道基，对修炼大有裨益。

每一份功德都会汇入仙骨，加速沉睡的胡笳本源苏醒。

二来，与人方便，也能快速在宗门站稳脚跟，摸清各方人脉。

“诸位师兄不必多礼，举手之劳而已。大家依次排队，一个一个来吧。”

她侧身将众人让进院内，就地盘膝而坐，开始催动【思无邪】音波。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

First-class single room!

The residences of the outer sect are divided into three grades: A, B, and C. The single rooms of grade A are spacious, clean, and filled with spiritual energy. They are places where only the most qualified and highly regarded disciples in the outer sect can stay.

As a genius with a single spiritual root, Cai Wenlong was only assigned to a second-class social courtyard.

And his good-for-nothing cousin, whom everyone despises, actually lives in a first-class single room as soon as he walks in?

The huge gap made the hostility in his heart even stronger. The hostility in his eyes when he looked at Cai Wenji almost reached the extreme.

Cai Wenji doesn't care about this. It doesn't matter where she lives, as long as she can settle down safely and slowly accumulate strength.

She bowed to thank Guanshi Zhou, took the house number and the sect's clothes, and followed the lead disciple to the residence of Outer Sect A and others.

The single-room courtyard is not big, with one house and one courtyard. There are several green bamboos planted in the courtyard. The breeze blows through the bamboos and rustles. The environment is quiet and elegant, which is really suitable for meditation.

After a brief tidying up, Cai Wenji put on the sect's unified light cyan outer sect clothes. Her soft and cute face paired with the plain clothes gave her a unique and smart charm.

As soon as he settled down, there was a knock on the door outside the courtyard.

When she opened the door, she saw that it was the outer monk whose old injury she had healed before, followed by several other disciples.

"Junior sister Cai, I'm Wang Lei, thank you so much for your help today, junior sister. I cannot thank you enough for your kindness!"

Wang Lei bowed his hands and saluted with a very sincere attitude:

"I heard that Junior Sister is proficient in the art of healing. We have some minor injuries and pains during our daily practice and experience. We came here to visit. I would like to ask Junior Sister to help sort things out."

It turned out that after Wang Lei returned, he spread the news that Cai Wenji had easily cured his chronic illness.

The entire outer door exploded instantly!

In the Qingfeng Sect, where resources are poor and elixirs are scarce, being able to heal injuries for free is a great blessing!

All of a sudden, many disciples from the outer sect came to the door one after another, queuing up to ask Cai Wenji to help treat her injuries.

Cai Wenji looked at the crowd of people outside the door and realized it instantly.

Good guy, as soon as she entered the sect, she was treated as an exclusive mobile blood pack?

In the canyon, teammates rushed to shout "nanny, save me". When they arrived at the cultivation world, all the disciples of the sect lined up to beg "junior sister, save me". The style of the painting was exactly the same!

She didn't know whether to laugh or cry, but she didn't refuse.

First, saving people and accumulating merit can nourish one's own musical foundation, which is of great benefit to one's cultivation.

Every merit will be collected into the immortal bones, accelerating the awakening of the sleeping Hujia's origin.

Secondly, it is easy to get along with people, and you can quickly establish a foothold in the sect and find out all the connections.

"Brothers, there is no need to be polite, it's just a matter of raising a finger. Everyone, line up in order and come one by one."

She turned sideways to let everyone into the courtyard, sat cross-legged on the spot, and began to activate the [Siwuxie] sound wave.
